grid_guard.title: Local grid-power guard
grid_guard.description: When enabled, missing, invalid or stale readings block running. Select the import sign using a known grid-consumption reading. Update the switch-control blueprint and select the device's Grid power blocked sensor. This is supplementary load management, not fuse protection.

error.no_devices: No controllable devices are available. Check the site schedule first.
error.invalid_grid_guard: Select a power sensor, positive pause and reading-age durations, and a resume limit lower than the stop limit. All numbers must be finite.
